title: Evening
label: ch:ta-evening
canDo: I can say மாலை for evening and keep it apart from the identically spelled garland word, which is a separate etymology rather than a second sense.

payoff.summary: Say mālai for evening, name the garland mālai as a distinct homonym, and mark the "darkness" link as plausible but not spelled out.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: TA-C27-maalai (810) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses both of its own atoms. The other three — ங and ள, the ீ sign, and reading நீங்கள் (TA-SCRIPT-NGA-LLA-01, TA-SCRIPT-II-SIGN-01, TA-SCRIPT-READ-NIINGAL-03) — are taught by TA-W11-read-niingal (815), sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and that script lesson is not a fitting payoff for the evening word.
